title: Anti-Inflammatory Drug and Endothelial Function
brief_summary: In this randomized double-blinded clinical trial, 400mg of hydroxychloroquine will be given daily to people over the age of 65 years with moderate-severe obstructive sleep apnea for 8 weeks. The aim of this study is to test whether hydroxychloroquine can improve endothelial function.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Apnea-Hypopnea index of 15 events/hour or higher

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication for hydroxychloroquine (retinopathy, chronic liver disease, chronic renal disease)
* Rheumatologic disease
